egress.terms: No published egress cap found on any pricing page. Vendor FAQ silent on bandwidth. Absence of a clause is not a guarantee.

interface_detail: Rclone. But CONDITIONAL. Vendor: 'Internxt now supports Rclone in two ways: via our object storage subscription, WebDAV, and natively. Rclone support is available for Ultimate plans.' WebDAV requires the Internxt CLI as a bridge, and rclone issue #7610 / internxt/cli#248 document that the WebDAV layer omits COPY and PROPPATCH, which breaks backup software.
tooling: CLI + WebDAV bridge + native rclone on Ultimate only. No S3.
chaining: WebDAV implementation lacks support for the COPY HTTP method, requiring file move and copy operations to transfer through local clients.

limits_note: Constraint type: write-gated (CLI bridge) + request-rate. StackSocial fine print: 'This is available to new users ONLY. Codes are NOT stackable' on the 10 TB and 100 TB SKUs. Directly contradicting the on-site stacking claim. VERIFY WHICH APPLIES.
reliability_note: Documented file-loss pattern, not a single incident: a GitHub controlled test uploaded 198 files and lost some; Trustpilot reviewers report 'Files disappear from time to time' and 'stored files are [gone]'; a 1-year user reported all images and videos gone with support unresponsive. Desktop sync described as non-functional by lifetime holders.
